newsitem.title: UK: BT shares down on weak Dow after Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: BT shares down on weak Dow after Q3 results.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) shares were marked down in pre-market trade on Thursday, but dealers said the drop was due to Wall Street's overnight fall rather than any disappointment at BT's third-quarter profits.
BT posted third-quarter pre-tax profits of 909 million stg after a 39 million stg redundancy charge. Analysts had expected profits in the range 860-920 million stg.
BT shares were four pence weaker at 440p by 0820 GMT.
"The results were fine but Wall Street came off overnight and the shares have had a good run recently, so they were bound to come off a few coppers (pence)," one market-maker said.
